prompt: Turn the person in this portrait into the character below, keeping exactly the same pixel-art style, outline weight, shading, pose, framing, lighting and flat dark background, with the same large, clearly drawn eyes, strong brows and defined mouth: a bright, reckless young alchemist of nineteen, an adult, slight and small in an oversized coat, with a wide, lively face and warm brown skin: broad cheekbones, full cheeks, a broad nose, large bright eager eyes, thick arched brows, a wide crooked grin showing her teeth, a smudge of green on one cheek. A big wild cloud of tight dark curls around her head and shoulders, one pale streak in them, held back by cracked brass goggles with round lenses pushed up on her forehead. An oversized patched dark rubber-leather coat, glossy, stained copper-green and pocked with pale acid burns; a woven wicker bandolier across her chest holding small glass flasks of yellow powder and glowing white liquid. A brass hose nozzle rises over her shoulder. Head and shoulders, her whole body, shoulders and face turned three-quarters toward the right, looking right, her head filling most of the frame; large, clearly drawn eyes, strong dark brows, a large defined mouth, bold dark outlines. A plain, flat, empty dark background. Lighting: a soft, dim warm amber rim light from the right, its lamp far out of frame and never visible, gentle warm fill, deep warm brown shadows. A plain dark background with no lamp, lantern or light source in the frame.
